# BBCode tag reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs`. Edit `src/bbcode/tags.ts` instead. -->

Every tag below is understood by the preview, IntelliSense, hovers and the
validator. The **Dialects** column lists the engines that provide the tag; a
dash means every dialect does. Change which set is active with the
`bbcode.dialect` setting.

There are **59** tags in total.

## Contents

- [Text formatting](#text-formatting) — 17 tags
- [Layout](#layout) — 12 tags
- [Lists](#lists) — 5 tags
- [Links](#links) — 4 tags
- [Media](#media) — 7 tags
- [Code](#code) — 5 tags
- [Tables](#tables) — 6 tags
- [Miscellaneous](#miscellaneous) — 3 tags

## Text formatting

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[b]` | `bold` | inline | — | Bold text. |
| `[i]` | `italic` | inline | — | Italic text. |
| `[u]` | `underline` | inline | — | Underlined text. |
| `[s]` | `strike`, `strikethrough`, `del` | inline | — | Struck-through text. |
| `[ins]` | — | inline | XenForo | Inserted text, rendered underlined. |
| `[sub]` | — | inline | — | Subscript text. |
| `[sup]` | — | inline | — | Superscript text. |
| `[color]` | `colour` | inline | — | Sets the text colour. Accepts a named CSS colour or a hex value. |
| `[bgcolor]` | `bg`, `highlight`, `mark` | inline | XenForo, MyBB | Sets the background (highlight) colour of the text. |
| `[size]` | — | inline | — | Sets the text size. Depending on the dialect the value is a percentage (phpBB), a 1-7 scale (vBulletin) or an explicit CSS length. |
| `[font]` | — | inline | — | Sets the font family. |
| `[h1]` | — | block | Steam, XenForo | A first-level heading. |
| `[h2]` | — | block | Steam, XenForo | A second-level heading. |
| `[h3]` | — | block | Steam, XenForo | A third-level heading. |
| `[h4]` | — | block | Generic | A fourth-level heading. |
| `[h5]` | — | block | Generic | A fifth-level heading. |
| `[h6]` | — | block | Generic | A sixth-level heading. |

### `[b]`

Bold text.

```bbcode
[b]important[/b]
```

### `[i]`

Italic text.

```bbcode
[i]emphasised[/i]
```

### `[u]`

Underlined text.

```bbcode
[u]underlined[/u]
```

### `[s]`

Struck-through text.

```bbcode
[s]removed[/s]
```

### `[ins]`

Inserted text, rendered underlined.

```bbcode
[ins]added later[/ins]
```

### `[sub]`

Subscript text.

```bbcode
H[sub]2[/sub]O
```

### `[sup]`

Superscript text.

```bbcode
x[sup]2[/sup]
```

### `[color]`

Sets the text colour. Accepts a named CSS colour or a hex value.

**Value** — A CSS colour name such as `red`, or a hex value such as `#ff8800`.

```bbcode
[color=#ff8800]orange[/color]
```

### `[bgcolor]`

Sets the background (highlight) colour of the text.

**Value** — A CSS colour name or hex value.

```bbcode
[bgcolor=yellow]highlighted[/bgcolor]
```

### `[size]`

Sets the text size. Depending on the dialect the value is a percentage (phpBB), a 1-7 scale (vBulletin) or an explicit CSS length.

**Value** — A percentage (`150`), a scale step (`1`-`7`) or a CSS length (`18px`).

```bbcode
[size=150]bigger[/size]
```

### `[font]`

Sets the font family.

**Value** — A font family name.

```bbcode
[font=Georgia]serif text[/font]
```

### `[h1]`

A first-level heading.

```bbcode
[h1]Title[/h1]
```

### `[h2]`

A second-level heading.

```bbcode
[h2]Section[/h2]
```

### `[h3]`

A third-level heading.

```bbcode
[h3]Subsection[/h3]
```

### `[h4]`

A fourth-level heading.

```bbcode
[h4]Heading[/h4]
```

### `[h5]`

A fifth-level heading.

```bbcode
[h5]Heading[/h5]
```

### `[h6]`

A sixth-level heading.

```bbcode
[h6]Heading[/h6]
```

## Layout

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[left]` | — | block | — | Left-aligns a block of text. |
| `[center]` | `centre` | block | — | Centres a block of text. |
| `[right]` | — | block | — | Right-aligns a block of text. |
| `[justify]` | — | block | phpBB, XenForo, MyBB | Justifies a block of text. |
| `[align]` | — | block | — | Aligns a block of text. |
| `[indent]` | — | block | — | Indents a block of text. |
| `[quote]` | — | block | — | Quotes another post. The optional value names the author. |
| `[spoiler]` | `hide`, `ispoiler` | block | XenForo, SMF, MyBB, Steam | Hides content behind a click-to-reveal box. |
| `[box]` | — | block | XenForo | Draws a bordered box around its content. |
| `[hr]` | `rule` | no closing tag | — | A horizontal rule. |
| `[br]` | — | no closing tag | MyBB | An explicit line break. |
| `[float]` | — | block | phpBB | Floats a block to one side so text wraps around it. |

### `[left]`

Left-aligns a block of text.

```bbcode
[left]left aligned[/left]
```

### `[center]`

Centres a block of text.

```bbcode
[center]centred[/center]
```

### `[right]`

Right-aligns a block of text.

```bbcode
[right]right aligned[/right]
```

### `[justify]`

Justifies a block of text.

```bbcode
[justify]justified[/justify]
```

### `[align]`

Aligns a block of text.

**Value** — The horizontal alignment to apply.

```bbcode
[align=center]centred[/align]
```

### `[indent]`

Indents a block of text.

**Value** — Number of indentation levels.

```bbcode
[indent]indented[/indent]
```

### `[quote]`

Quotes another post. The optional value names the author.

**Value** — Name of the person being quoted.

**Parameters**

- `post` — ID of the quoted post.
- `source` — Where the quote came from.
- `link` — A URL pointing at the quoted post.
- `date` — Timestamp of the quoted post.

```bbcode
[quote="Alice"]Hello there.[/quote]
```

### `[spoiler]`

Hides content behind a click-to-reveal box.

**Value** — Label shown on the collapsed box.

```bbcode
[spoiler=Ending]They were dead all along.[/spoiler]
```

### `[box]`

Draws a bordered box around its content.

**Value** — Optional box heading.

```bbcode
[box=Note]Remember to save.[/box]
```

### `[hr]`

A horizontal rule.

```bbcode
[hr]
```

### `[br]`

An explicit line break.

```bbcode
[br]
```

### `[float]`

Floats a block to one side so text wraps around it.

**Value** — Side to float towards.

```bbcode
[float=right][img]logo.png[/img][/float]
```

## Lists

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[list]` | — | block | — | A list. Without a value the list is bulleted; with one it is numbered. |
| `[ul]` | — | block | XenForo, Steam | An explicitly bulleted list. |
| `[ol]` | `olist` | block | XenForo, Steam | An explicitly numbered list. |
| `[*]` | — | list item | — | A list item. The closing tag is optional; the next item closes it. |
| `[li]` | — | block | XenForo, Steam | A list item with an explicit closing tag. |

### `[list]`

A list. Without a value the list is bulleted; with one it is numbered.

**Value** — Numbering style.

```bbcode
[list]
[*]First
[*]Second
[/list]
```

### `[ul]`

An explicitly bulleted list.

```bbcode
[ul][li]First[/li][/ul]
```

### `[ol]`

An explicitly numbered list.

**Value** — Numbering style.

```bbcode
[ol][li]First[/li][/ol]
```

### `[*]`

A list item. The closing tag is optional; the next item closes it.

```bbcode
[*]An item
```

### `[li]`

A list item with an explicit closing tag.

```bbcode
[li]An item[/li]
```

## Links

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[url]` | `link` | inline | — | A hyperlink. Use `[url]http://…[/url]` or `[url=http://…]label[/url]`. |
| `[email]` | — | inline | — | A `mailto:` link. |
| `[user]` | `mention` | inline | XenForo, vBulletin | A mention of another forum member. |
| `[anchor]` | — | inline | SMF | Defines a named anchor that can be linked to with `[goto]`. |

### `[url]`

A hyperlink. Use `[url]http://…[/url]` or `[url=http://…]label[/url]`.

**Value** — Target address.

**Parameters**

- `unfurl` — XenForo: render as a rich link preview.

```bbcode
[url=https://example.com]Example[/url]
```

### `[email]`

A `mailto:` link.

**Value** — The e-mail address.

```bbcode
[email]someone@example.com[/email]
```

### `[user]`

A mention of another forum member.

**Value** — Numeric member ID.

```bbcode
[user=42]Alice[/user]
```

### `[anchor]`

Defines a named anchor that can be linked to with `[goto]`.

**Value** — Anchor name.

```bbcode
[anchor=top]Top of page[/anchor]
```

## Media

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[img]` | `image` | inline | — | Embeds an image. The URL goes in the content or in the value. |
| `[youtube]` | `yt` | block | phpBB, vBulletin, SMF, MyBB | Embeds a YouTube video from a full URL or a bare video ID. |
| `[vimeo]` | — | block | phpBB | Embeds a Vimeo video from a full URL or a bare video ID. |
| `[media]` | — | block | XenForo | XenForo-style embed. The value selects the provider. |
| `[video]` | — | block | SMF | Embeds a video file or a supported video URL. |
| `[audio]` | — | block | Generic | Embeds an audio file. |
| `[attach]` | `attachment` | inline | XenForo, vBulletin | References a file attached to the post. |

### `[img]`

Embeds an image. The URL goes in the content or in the value.

**Value** — Image URL. Some engines put the width here instead.

**Parameters**

- `width` — Display width in pixels.
- `height` — Display height in pixels.
- `alt` — Alternative text.
- `title` — Tooltip text.

```bbcode
[img]https://example.com/cat.png[/img]
```

### `[youtube]`

Embeds a YouTube video from a full URL or a bare video ID.

```bbcode
[youtube]dQw4w9WgXcQ[/youtube]
```

### `[vimeo]`

Embeds a Vimeo video from a full URL or a bare video ID.

```bbcode
[vimeo]76979871[/vimeo]
```

### `[media]`

XenForo-style embed. The value selects the provider.

**Value** — Media provider.

```bbcode
[media=youtube]dQw4w9WgXcQ[/media]
```

### `[video]`

Embeds a video file or a supported video URL.

**Value** — Optional provider hint.

```bbcode
[video]https://example.com/clip.mp4[/video]
```

### `[audio]`

Embeds an audio file.

```bbcode
[audio]https://example.com/song.mp3[/audio]
```

### `[attach]`

References a file attached to the post.

**Value** — How to display the attachment.

```bbcode
[attach]12345[/attach]
```

## Code

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[code]` | — | block | — | A block of preformatted code. BBCode inside is not parsed. |
| `[icode]` | `inlinecode`, `c` | inline | XenForo | Inline preformatted code. |
| `[pre]` | — | block | SMF | Preformatted text that keeps whitespace exactly as written. |
| `[php]` | — | block | vBulletin, MyBB, SMF | A block of PHP source code. |
| `[noparse]` | `plain`, `nobbc` | block | — | Shows its content verbatim, without interpreting any BBCode. |

### `[code]`

A block of preformatted code. BBCode inside is not parsed.

**Value** — Language hint, shown as a label.

**Parameters**

- `title` — Caption shown above the block.
- `lang` — Language hint (XenForo spelling).

```bbcode
[code=js]console.log("hi");[/code]
```

### `[icode]`

Inline preformatted code.

```bbcode
[icode]npm install[/icode]
```

### `[pre]`

Preformatted text that keeps whitespace exactly as written.

```bbcode
[pre]  spaced   out[/pre]
```

### `[php]`

A block of PHP source code.

```bbcode
[php]echo "hi";[/php]
```

### `[noparse]`

Shows its content verbatim, without interpreting any BBCode.

```bbcode
[noparse][b]not bold[/b][/noparse]
```

## Tables

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[table]` | — | block | phpBB, XenForo, MyBB | A table. Contains `[tr]` rows. |
| `[thead]` | — | block | XenForo | The header section of a table. |
| `[tbody]` | — | block | XenForo | The body section of a table. |
| `[tr]` | — | block | phpBB, XenForo, MyBB | A table row. |
| `[td]` | — | block | phpBB, XenForo, MyBB | A table cell. |
| `[th]` | — | block | phpBB, XenForo, MyBB | A table header cell. |

### `[table]`

A table. Contains `[tr]` rows.

```bbcode
[table][tr][td]A[/td][/tr][/table]
```

### `[thead]`

The header section of a table.

```bbcode
[thead][tr][th]Name[/th][/tr][/thead]
```

### `[tbody]`

The body section of a table.

```bbcode
[tbody][tr][td]A[/td][/tr][/tbody]
```

### `[tr]`

A table row.

```bbcode
[tr][td]A[/td][td]B[/td][/tr]
```

### `[td]`

A table cell.

**Parameters**

- `colspan` — Number of columns the cell spans.
- `rowspan` — Number of rows the cell spans.
- `align` — Horizontal alignment.

```bbcode
[td]A cell[/td]
```

### `[th]`

A table header cell.

**Parameters**

- `colspan` — Number of columns the cell spans.
- `rowspan` — Number of rows the cell spans.
- `align` — Horizontal alignment.

```bbcode
[th]Column[/th]
```

## Miscellaneous

| Tag | Aliases | Kind | Dialects | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[abbr]` | `acronym` | inline | SMF | An abbreviation with an explanatory tooltip. |
| `[tt]` | `monospace` | inline | SMF | Monospaced text. |
| `[time]` | — | inline | phpBB | A timestamp rendered in the reader’s local time zone. |

### `[abbr]`

An abbreviation with an explanatory tooltip.

**Value** — The expanded form.

```bbcode
[abbr=HyperText Markup Language]HTML[/abbr]
```

### `[tt]`

Monospaced text.

```bbcode
[tt]fixed width[/tt]
```

### `[time]`

A timestamp rendered in the reader’s local time zone.

```bbcode
[time]1700000000[/time]
```
